title: Night Watch
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: Commander Sam Vimes of the Ankh-Morpork City Watch is thrown back in time to the city of his youth, just before a street uprising. He must work with his younger self's mentor and play a part in events he remembers.
readIf: you enjoy Discworld at its most serious, mixing humor with political and moral weight.
skipIf: you want the lighter, purely comic side of Discworld.
